# Start a project with Effect Forge

Help me start a product using <https://github.com/mateoroldos/effect-forge>.

Read its `VISION.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and relevant code. Inspect any existing product
work before proposing changes.

Interview me one question at a time about users, purpose, workflows, boundaries,
and signs of success. Recommend a default when useful. Use examples to expose
tradeoffs, and do not ask me to repeat facts available in the repository.

Once the first useful slice is clear, summarize our decisions. Use the repository's
[docs/template/adapt-template.md](adapt-template.md)
to propose what to copy, edit, keep optionally, or remove. Inspect connected code,
schemas, deployment resources, and tooling before proposing removal.

Wait for agreement, then write a short product `VISION.md` and build the first slice.
Adapt the agent instructions and README to the resulting project. Remove stale
template guidance with the code it describes; finish the adoption cleanup in that guide.
Run the checks and report results, remaining work, and behavior not verified.
